# Agentic Protocols Developer Portal

Exposing open standards for AI agent integration, commerce, and payments.

## Core Protocols

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io): Secure two-way connections between data sources and AI agents.
- [Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)](https://agenticprotocols.dev/ucp.html): Uniform semantic API contract for agentic catalog discovery, cart management, and checkouts.
- [Agentic Payment Protocol (APP)](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-agents-to-payments-ap2-protocol): Secure, autonomous stablecoin micro-payments and wallet schemas.

## Bootcamps & Training

- [5-Day Bootcamp: Generative AI & Agentic AI](https://agenticprotocols.dev/training-genai-agentic-journey.html): Mastering LLM applications, LangGraph, and multi-agent workflows.
- [1-Day Bootcamp: Agentic AI Immersive](https://agenticprotocols.dev/training-oneday-agentic-bootcamp.html): Hands-on training for ReAct loops, tool calling, and state machines.

## Articles & Architectural Patterns

### Agentic Architectural Patterns
- [Single Agent Patterns: Reason and Act Loop](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-single-agent-patterns-reason-and-act-loop.html): Part 1 on interleaving thoughts and tool execution.
- [Single Agent Patterns: Plan-Then-Execute](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-single-agent-patterns-plan-then-execute.html): Part 2 on decoupling planning from execution for long-horizon coherence.
- [Single Agent Patterns: Search over Actions](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-single-agent-patterns-search-over-actions.html): Part 3 on exploring alternative action sequences using tree/graph search policies.
- [Single Agent Patterns: Reflection and Self-Correction](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-single-agent-patterns-reflection-and-self-correction.html): Part 4 on evaluating outputs, storing mistakes in episodic memory, and executing grounded correction retries.

### Protocols & Specifications
- [What is the x402 Protocol?](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-what-is-x402-protocol.html): Open micro-payment standard utilizing the HTTP 402 status code.
- [What is Universal Commerce Protocol?](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-what-is-universal-commerce-protocol.html): Standardized e-commerce communication for autonomous agent purchase loops.
- [Integrating UCP: The Python SDK](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-integrating-ucp-python-sdk.html): Developer guide for implementing ucp-py.
- [What are Agentic Interfaces?](https://agenticprotocols.dev/article-what-are-agentic-interfaces.html): Standardized pathways for agent-to-agent and tool-based communications.
